answer: Every agent posts a per-identity bridge voucher stamped by an off-chain quill that time-stamps the vine’s root, sealing to the nebula’s clock. When peers re-execute receipts, each fake must re-stamp its root with a fresh quill pull, adding 2.1 hours of wall-time latency per head, as the quill’s entropy resets each epoch and farms can’t pre-compute stamps—serial time per Sybil breaks the attack’s parallelism.
